sections.Profile:
"Lightning," released by Stern Electronics in 1981, features a captivating Norse mythology theme with dual-level playfields and a fast-paced, action-packed design. The game includes a 3-ball multiball system, challenging drop targets, and a unique timed bonus ball mode.
